title: Made a way for your coding agent to set up servers and matchmaking for your multiplayer game
author: Asleep-Mix-7487
selftext:
Hey all,  
  
If you’ve built a multiplayer game with AI tools, you’ve probably hit this wall: the game works locally, and then you need real servers, matchmaking, and some way to rank players. That’s usually three separate systems to set up and glue together.  
  
We built GameFlow to handle all three in one place: worldwide game server hosting, matchmaking, and skill rating. It integrates with your existing game backend, whether that’s Supabase, Nakama, Talo, or your own custom setup.  
  
What’s relevant for this sub is that it comes with an MCP server, a CLI, and an API. That means your coding agent can integrate, deploy, and configure the servers for you.  
  
I’ll drop the link in the comments. I’d like honest feedback from people building multiplayer games with agents. What’s confusing, what breaks, what’s missing? :)
